name: iggy
caption:
IGGY 🎮🏀 He didn't start a single game all season. Then he won Finals MVP.

• 2015 Finals: we're down 2-1, Andre Iguodala makes his first start of the season
• Game 4: 22 points
• Finals: 16.3 PPG, and LeBron shoots 38.1% with him on the floor
• First player ever to win Finals MVP without starting a regular-season game
• His No. 9 is retired. Steph and Draymond are still here from that team

Finals MVP: Iggy or Steph? 👇

beats.head: SIXTH MAN
beats.name: IGGY
beats.vo: Andre Iguodala doesn't start a single game for us all season. Then he wins Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: ZERO STARTS ALL SEASON...|THEN FINALS MVP.

beats.head: GAME 4
beats.name: IGGY
beats.vo: Twenty fifteen Finals. We're down two games to one. Steve Kerr starts him for the first time all year. He scores twenty-two.
beats.dlg: DOWN 2-1 IN THE FINALS.|HE STARTS. 22 POINTS.

beats.head: LEBRON STOPPER
beats.name: IGGY
beats.vo: Sixteen point three a night. And with Iggy on the floor, LeBron shoots just thirty-eight percent.

beats.head: FINALS MVP
beats.name: IGGY
beats.vo: We win the title. He's Finals MVP, the first ever without starting a regular-season game. His number nine now hangs in our rafters.
beats.dlg: FINALS MVP. 4 TITLES.|NO. 9 IN OUR RAFTERS.

beats.head: STILL HERE
beats.name: DRAYMOND
beats.vo: Two guys from that team are still with us. Steph, and Draymond Green, dishing seven point eight assists through eight games.

beats.head: IGGY OR STEPH?
beats.vo: Finals MVP: Iggy or Steph? Comment below.
beats.dlg: FINALS MVP: IGGY OR STEPH?|COMMENT BELOW!

facts.claim: 2015 Finals: Warriors down 2–1, Iguodala made his first start of the season (0 regular-season starts) in Game 4 and scored a season-high 22 points; averaged 16.3 points; James shot 38.1% with Iguodala in the game; Finals MVP, first to win it without starting a game in the regular season; 4× NBA champion; No. 9 retired by Golden State
Draymond Green: 4× NBA champion (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022), with Golden State 2012–present
Stephen Curry: 4× NBA champion including 2015, Warriors 2009–present
